notes: I read every claim's doc text at design/spec.md 15405-15700 in W (02745494) and the matching code. The one probe script is /Users/miguel/.julia/dev/Redstone.jl/design/reports/20261124_doc_conformance/probes/C1_v/probe.jl. I ran it once from W with --project=test and it printed the P1-P7 results cited above. I changed no tracked file. 26 of the 31 claims conform and 5 do not. C1-065 is drift: D-437 gives a bare side the face u or y, never an empty name. C1-205 and C1-209 are deviations: ProducedByTwoStages and DeclaredNotProduced carry a list of ports, but the doc and D-252 name one port. C1-047 is drift: the group label '(the structure step)' does not hold for MissingProbeValue, the cell layout's IllegalPortType arms and x_projection's DeclarationOnWrongTier arms, which the nominal evaluation raises (§9.1 and D-259 already say so). Outside my claims: (1) ClassUnreadable's 'did-you-mean when the type holds component-typed fields' is only a Bool (holds_components, src/diagnostics.jl:587) with no field list. (2) FaceNameCollision's :root site has path \"\", while the doc says 'Assembly path'.
